question.problem: In January $2022,$ a social media account had approximately $53,000$ followers. In December of that year, the account had $120%$ the number of followers it had in January. Determine the number of followers the account had in December, $2022.$
question.worked_solution:
To solve this problem, we can use the formula:

$$
\text{part}=\text{percentage}\times \text{whole}
$$

In our case, the whole is the number of followers the account had in January, $2022,$ which is $53,000.$ The percentage is $120%,$ and the part is the number of followers the account had in December $2022.$

**Method 1**

First, we convert the percentage to a decimal:

$$
120%=120÷100=1.2
$$

Applying our formula, we have:

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{part} & =\text{percentage}\times \text{whole} \\  & =120%\times 53,000 \\  & =1.2\times 53,000 \\  & =63,600\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $120%$ of $53,000$ is $63,600.$ So, the social media account had $63,600$ followers in December $2022.$

**Method 2**

First, we convert the percentage to a fraction:

$$
120%=\frac{120}{100}=\frac{120÷20}{100÷20}=\frac{6}{5}
$$

Applying our formula, we have:

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{part} & =\text{percentage}\times \text{whole} \\  & =120%\times 53,000 \\  & =\frac{6}{5}\times 53,000 \\  & =6\times \frac{53,000}{5} \\  & =6\times 10,600 \\  & =63,600\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $120%$ of $53,000$ is $63,600.$ So, the social media account had $63,600$ followers in December $2022.$
